blocks.text: Some weddings start in a garden. Others start in a church. In Cebu, a surprising number of them start in a ballroom at Radisson Blu. For ten years, Something Blu has quietly done something that no vendor catalogue quite manages — it puts the right people in the same room. Couples arrive with half-formed ideas and leave with florists, photographers, and a shortlist of venues. Suppliers come to fill their calendars and leave with collaborators. What looks like a weekend trade fair has, over a decade, become something closer to a gathering point for how Cebuano weddings actually get made. The […]...
